trace.notes: Input URL https://zbmath.org/7102580 could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. The zbMATH page and zbMATH API endpoints were not readable in the local workflow because shell fetches failed with DNS/network resolution errors, and browser fetches exposed no readable document body. Exact-work recovery identified DOI 10.1109/ICST.2015.7102580 and title metadata for Harman, Jia, and Zhang, 'Achievements, Open Problems and Challenges for Search Based Software Testing'. Candidate pages inspected included UCL Discovery, DBLP, GP-bibliography, ResearchGate, DOI/IEEE links, and the author PDF URL; UCL/DBLP/GP-bibliography/ResearchGate were metadata or abstract/citation pages rather than full technical source text, and direct PDF candidates could not be fetched as readable artifacts. No questions were extracted from abstracts, snippets, or resolver metadata.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7102580.json and outputs/latest.json.
